main.שם היחידה: chart-units, chart-heat, chart-rate, chart-status-units, chart-scatter, kpi:units, insight:leader, insight:volume, insight:collection — the unit that issued the charge (about 20 units)
main.סטטוס תנועה: chart-years, chart-status, chart-status-units, chart-reasons, kpi:count, kpi:waived, insight:exempt — פעילה / פטור / מבוטלת / מוקפאת; only פעילה counts as billed
main.סוג האגרה: chart-types, insight:type_gap — periodic (annual) vs service fees
main.סכום בשקלים: chart-years, chart-units, chart-heat, chart-amounts, chart-scatter, kpi:billed, kpi:last, kpi:change, insight:trend
main.יתרה להתאמה: chart-years, chart-units, chart-rate, chart-types, kpi:rate, kpi:open, insight:collection, insight:rate_trend — unpaid part of an active charge (0 when paid, the full amount when not)
main.סיבת פטור וביטול: chart-reasons, insight:exempt — free text; case numbers are stripped and only reasons with 100+ charges are named
main._resource_name: chart-years, chart-status, chart-types, chart-heat, kpi:span — one file per year; the year in the file name is the charge year
main.קוד תנועה: skip: row identifier; not fetched (columns) to keep the 14M-row export small
main.תאריך סטטוס תנועה: skip: status date; not fetched to keep the export small, the page works per charge year
main.סוג תיק: skip: case type, nearly one-to-one with the unit (משכון, חברה, עמותה, …); not fetched
main.שם האגרה: skip: fee name (about 220 values a year, about 26 bytes a row); not fetched to keep the 14M-row export under the memory budget, fee type and unit carry the story
main.תאריך עדכון סכום: skip: amount update date; not fetched
main.שנת חיוב: skip: billing year, mostly empty for service fees; the file year is used instead; not fetched
main.שנת החיוב: skip: the 2019 file's spelling of שנת חיוב; not fetched
main.תאריך פתיחת חיוב: skip: charge opening date; the 2019 file names it differently, so it cannot be a by_schema column; the file year is used instead
main.תאריך פתיחת החיוב: skip: the 2019 file's spelling of תאריך פתיחת חיוב; not fetched
main.סטטוס התאמה: skip: payment-match status, redundant with יתרה להתאמה (fully matched = zero balance); not fetched
main.סטטוס ההתאמה: skip: the 2019 file's spelling of סטטוס התאמה; not fetched
main.תאריך סטטוס ההתאמה: skip: the 2019 file's spelling of תאריך סטטוס התאמה; not fetched
main.שנת התיישנות החוב: skip: debt limitation year, mostly empty; not fetched
main.תאריך הוספה: skip: record insert date; not fetched
